provenance: Recovered from active MIRLEX hard-radar context after GitHub write access was restored. Preserve IDs exactly. Cards with incomplete source trail are preservation records, not publication-ready legal conclusions.

rop.summary: Interagency cross-check of ROP data with FTS, Minpromtorg, CRPT and FNS.
Chestny ZNAK / GIS MT used as a control source for identifying potentially obligated entities and warnings.
Contract manufacturing/private label: risk of identifying the wrong producer/obligated entity; verify actual release and GIS MT.
Recycler register: verify recycler, operation, group/waste and evidence; contract alone is insufficient.
Act alone is insufficient; factual recycling and output/reuse are checked.
Enhanced sanctions under Art. 8.41.1 KoAP from 2026; exact current wording/amounts must be revalidated before use.
Administrative case may be initiated without a separate control event; revalidate current procedural basis before use.
Importer base can be reconstructed from customs/shipping documents; source and current control mechanics must be revalidated.
Recycler can become eco-fee payer for unconfirmed recycling; revalidate exact legal mechanism.
Recycler act constrained by registry inclusion date and confirmed capacity.
Broadened exposure for inaccurate ROP reporting from 03.03.2026; revalidate current KoAP wording.
Recycler inspection alone does not automatically prove a producer/importer debt for historic periods; preserve as court-evidence pattern.
Defective/cancelled recycler inspection act can undermine evidentiary basis.
Actual technological capacity is a central verification parameter for recycler compliance.
Sorting/secondary material alone may not satisfy recycling; check waste-to-product technological correspondence.
Historic subcontracting pattern: under current ROP trace the final recycler, not only intermediary chain.
Rosprirodnadzor must prove violation by the specific obligated entity; preserve as evidentiary/court pattern for historic periods.
Producer/importer recycling act can be cross-checked with recycler quarterly reporting.
Recycler register is dynamic; check status, capacity and product/operation across the relevant period.
Packaging moves to 100% recycling norm from 2027 — MUST REVALIDATE before use.
Three ROP forms operate as a dependent calculation chain: mass → recycling → eco-fee.
Anti-double-count: same secondary raw material mass cannot be simultaneously counted for self-recycling and reducing coefficient; revalidate exact rule.
Non-EAEU importer reporting transition delayed to 01.01.2028 — MUST REVALIDATE before use.
Recycler exclusion from register does not automatically invalidate earlier recycling; check inclusion/exclusion date and factual volume.
Recycling act may be issued after factual recycling, but recycling itself must fall within the reporting year; revalidate current form rules.
PP 2394 waste/secondary raw material → product mapping changes from 01.01.2027 under PP 370; versioned dataset required.

industry.summary: Water protection zone can be a stop-factor for car-wash activity; location/water-body/protection-zone is an early filter.
Hidden tank/wastewater collection defect can turn water issue into soil contamination and environmental damage; trace the full physical route.
Land plot/VRI must be checked before environmental documents; improper land use can lead to dismantling/termination risks.
Auxiliary drying/burner in printing can be a major air-emission source; reconstruct actual process and exhaust.
Smell/smoke complaint requires analysis of actual operating regime/time/process, not document-only review.
Textile diagnostics must reconstruct actual processes before trusting a 'not registered as NVOС' status.
Wet textile processes require two-level wastewater analysis: resident pretreatment → industrial park/central system → common treatment/final discharge.
Contamination of textile materials changes the waste route; classify by origin/use/contaminant, not only material name.
Packaging manufacturer needs a zero-stage product-legality filter before plant compliance; material/color/multilayer/label can matter.
Chemical residues 'stored on own territory' are not automatically lawfully accumulated; trace residue-to-surface/soil/receiver.
LKM equipment washing/cleanout is an independent waste/water node; determine what happens between batches.
Recipe/raw-material/solvent/process changes must trigger review of emission inventory relevance.
LKM waste identification must follow recipe and stage of generation, not generic 'paint waste' labels.
Household-chemistry process upset/off-spec batch/overflow can turn normal sewer route into concentrated pollutant pathway.
Polymer film/plastics: extrusion/thermal process activates air/NVOС/PEC/NMU and full operational waste map.
Construction requires a full environmental lifecycle from project/site status to closure and transition to operation.
Discharge/WWTP must be traced through efficiency, sludge, soil/water-protection and incident consequences.
LOS/stormwater/industrial sewer is an operational lifecycle: design → commissioning → maintenance → lab → sludge/waste → repair → retest.
PLARN is an operational readiness and incident-response lifecycle, not only a document.
Livestock/poultry: determine by-product-vs-waste status and trace storage, treatment, land use, wastewater, air and bio-waste.
Own borehole is a cross-industry lifecycle: subsoil right/licence/zone/operation/accounting → wastewater → closure.
Zero-stage site gate: 'can this business be located here?' before environmental documents.
Woodworking/pil sawmill: aspiration/air/NVOС/PEC + wood residues + coatings/glues + boiler if present.
Concrete/JBI/paving: site/SZZ → cement handling/GOUs → noise → washing/water → concrete sludge/waste.
STO/autoservice: site/VRI gate plus oils/batteries/tires, welding, sandblasting, painting, washing/stormwater, air/noise.
Manure/litter → processing → product/fertilizer → land is a separate end-to-end control route.
Food industry needs a parent route plus subindustry modules; early split by water source and production wastewater route.
Construction soil/materials need status determination and final-destination tracing; 'soil' is not an automatic exemption.
Universal physical accumulation-area check: material → surface/protection → amount/time → documents → recipient → actual destination.

universal.summary: Environmental responsibility map: impact creator → owner → tenant → operator → subscriber → operational boundary → documents/contracts → costs/regress.
Environmental incident protocol: sampling, inspection, photos, remarks, reserve/parallel samples, lab, timing and evidence handling.
Physical tracing of water/wastewater: operation → material → wash/CIP/equipment → local treatment → mixing → control point → declaration → sample.
Hidden operation inside a simple business: do not trust business name/OKVED; inspect boiler, welding, painting, sharpening, battery charging, generator, woodworking, furnace, process exhaust, etc.
